builder.name: Code Builder
builder.description: Proposes minimal code changes against a spec, reports verification honestly, and provides complete current source for review.
conversation_starters: New task — here's the spec and relevant files.
Here's the latest audit report and current source. Fix only must_fix.
Plan only: outline the change and wait for approval.
Make the smallest safe change and include the full updated file.

capabilities.note: Code Interpreter is optional for self-contained checks and does not provide repository or CI access.

auditor.name: Code Auditor
auditor.description: Reviews supplied source against acceptance criteria and project standards, with evidence-based findings and a three-audit cap.
conversation_starters: Audit this complete Builder packet against the spec.
Audit the complete supplied current source against the spec; use the diff as supplemental context, map every criterion to evidence, and list anything missing.
Re-check this revision against the previous must_fix and deferred findings; preserve task-wide finding IDs.
Run the seeded smoke-test fixture and report evidence honestly.

capabilities.note: Use only for safe, self-contained code; distinguish sandbox checks from project CI.
